skills_invoked: {"skill": "team-ops:team-lead", "args": "Write up a failed-run lesson: inherited diagnosis (\"stale app image embedded in kernel; compare image IDs\") accepted by implementer, three rebuild rounds, failure unchanged; image IDs are slot numbers that repeat across builds so they could never discrimina

judge.reason: The write-up is blameless and names system factors: the diagnosis was accepted without testing its discriminator, there was no investigation before editing, and no cap on rework rounds without new evidence. It proposes checkable actions (an observed/inferred/untested handoff template, a pre-edit disproof step, a two-round stop, and an eval case with a pass criterion), and it records cost honestly as unknown. It falls short because only the eval case says how to tell whether the action worked, and it never says where the entry is kept or that the next run reads it; it only offers to append once the user names a tracker.
